title: Tensor pool usage digest — regional cadence (Jul 2026)
content:
Export type: compact-sheet (engineers ops view)
Scope: per-cluster / per-pool utilization cadence across APAC / EU / NA for 2026-07-17 -> 2026-07-23
Notes: this export focuses on slice-level occupancy and short burst window behavior; includes derived fragmentation index and a simple headroom projection column used by SRE for pre-warm decisions.

Columns: date, region, cluster_id, pool_name, total_accelerators, active_slices, avg_occupancy_pct, p95_latency_ms, headroom_pct, frag_idx, peak_epoch_hour, owner_oncall, note

2026-07-17, APAC, cl-apac-09, inference-pool-small, 64, 51, 79, 11.2, 21, 0.18, 14, SRE-A, "evening surge tied to Canary A/B rollout; frag_idx up after manual reservation change"
2026-07-17, EU, cl-eu-02, training-reserve-large, 128, 96, 75, 23.8, 25, 0.12, 03, SRE-B, "overnight batch jobs; consistent with schedule"
2026-07-17, NA, cl-na-11, ded-blend-medium, 96, 62, 64, 9.7, 36, 0.27, 17, SRE-C, "microbursts at 17:00; tail latency acceptable but headroom low for 2-hour window"

2026-07-18, APAC, cl-apac-09, inference-pool-small, 64, 56, 87, 12.6, 13, 0.21, 15, SRE-A, "post-deploy routing increased load; consider soft-throttle on non-critical routes"
2026-07-18, EU, cl-eu-02, training-reserve-large, 128, 72, 56, 20.1, 44, 0.09, 02, SRE-B, "training pipeline backfilled; headroom healthy"
2026-07-18, NA, cl-na-04, ded-blend-medium, 96, 70, 73, 11.1, 27, 0.19, 16, SRE-C, "planned pre-warm executed at 15:30; improved p95"

2026-07-19, APAC, cl-apac-12, realtime-edge, 32, 28, 88, 8.5, 12, 0.15, 11, SRE-A, "stable; recommend leaving async cache TTL at 30s"
2026-07-19, EU, cl-eu-05, batch-lowcost, 64, 38, 59, 30.7, 41, 0.32, 04, SRE-B, "high fragmentation (old reservations), consider consolidation"
2026-07-19, NA, cl-na-11, ded-blend-medium, 96, 84, 87, 10.9, 10, 0.14, 18, SRE-C, "evening load, but low frag_idx after rebalancing"

2026-07-20, APAC, cl-apac-09, inference-pool-small, 64, 61, 95, 15.4, 6, 0.25, 16, SRE-A, "sustained peak; paging threshold breached for 18m — triggered autoscale target increment request"
2026-07-20, EU, cl-eu-02, training-reserve-large, 128, 99, 77, 25.6, 23, 0.11, 01, SRE-B, "long-running job stuck; tracked in INFRA-3421"
2026-07-20, NA, cl-na-06, onprem-dedicated, 80, 40, 50, 14.9, 50, 0.41, 09, SRE-C, "scheduled maintenance reduces usable slices; headroom warning"

2026-07-21, APAC, cl-apac-12, realtime-edge, 32, 16, 50, 9.1, 50, 0.05, 12, SRE-A, "drop in regional traffic; safe to lower pre-warm counts"
2026-07-21, EU, cl-eu-05, batch-lowcost, 64, 20, 31, 40.2, 69, 0.48, 05, SRE-B, "very low occupancy, fragmentation high — candidate for pool shrink"
2026-07-21, NA, cl-na-11, ded-blend-medium, 96, 72, 75, 10.3, 28, 0.22, 20, SRE-C, "typical load"

2026-07-22, APAC, cl-apac-09, inference-pool-small, 64, 45, 70, 10.4, 30, 0.16, 17, SRE-A, "shifting routing brought down load; investigate canary rollback timing"
2026-07-22, EU, cl-eu-02, training-reserve-large, 128, 36, 28, 21.9, 78, 0.54, 02, SRE-B, "training window ended early; large headroom, plan cost-saving shrink"
2026-07-22, NA, cl-na-04, ded-blend-medium, 96, 65, 68, 9.9, 32, 0.18, 19, SRE-C, "slight microbursts at 19:00 but headroom okay"

2026-07-23, APAC, cl-apac-12, realtime-edge, 32, 30, 94, 8.3, 6, 0.11, 10, SRE-A, "pre-warm bump at 09:00 for scheduled event; performed as expected"
2026-07-23, EU, cl-eu-05, batch-lowcost, 64, 44, 69, 33.4, 31, 0.28, 07, SRE-B, "some backfills; fragmentation improves after consolidation"
2026-07-23, NA, cl-na-06, onprem-dedicated, 80, 60, 75, 12.2, 25, 0.13, 21, SRE-C, "post-maintenance ramp; metrics within SLOs"

Derived definitions (short):
- frag_idx (fragmentation index) = 1 - (active_slices / ceil(total_accelerators / target_slice_size)), target_slice_size=1 for inference pools, 2 for training pools in this export. Higher is worse; >0.3 flagged.
- headroom_pct = max(0, 100 - avg_occupancy_pct) simplified for quick ops decisioning.
- peak_epoch_hour = hour (0-23) of highest rolling 60-min occupancy in the day.

Quick observations:
- APAC inference pools (cl-apac-09) show consistent evening peaks tied to our staged canary rollouts; frag_idx increases after manual reservations. Action: recommend adding a cadence rule to hold 10% warm capacity for canaries in this pool.
- EU training reserves (cl-eu-02) show large day-to-day variance; two days had >70% occupancy driven by ad-hoc long-running jobs. Action: schedule stricter job batching and add pre-approval for >24h runs. See INFRA-3421.
- NA onprem cluster (cl-na-06) exhibited low headroom during maintenance window; we should reserve a cross-region fallback pool for critical routes during maintenance.

Suggested next steps (ops):
1) Add automated frag_idx alerts for >0.35 with runbook link.
2) Implement a short-lived pre-warm policy for inference-pool-small during canary/tiered rollouts (target 10% capacity).
3) Evaluate batch-lowcost pool (cl-eu-05) for consolidation — low occupancy and high fragmentation on 2026-07-21 suggests waste.
4) Link telemetry to rollout metadata so we can correlate deploys -> spikes automatically.

Appendix: small chart keys (not embedded)
- occupancy timeseries: avg_occupancy_pct by hour (available in telemetry export ID GH:repo/infra-telemetry#128)
- event map: deployments and Canary IDs mapped to peak_epoch_hour (see CONFLUENCE:INFRA/tensor-pools-operational-playbook)

Operational contacts: Marcus Chen (owner), Asha Banerjee (SRE lead), Diego Marquez (capacity planner)

Comments: this sheet is intentionally compact for quick triage; if we want a flattened per-hour table or a full hourly heatmap export, request via INFRA-3421 with scope=hourly_heatmap.
